channel.title: SBHLA Louie D. Newton Sermons (Personal Archive)
channel.description: Personal listening feed for sermons by Louie D. Newton, longtime pastor of Druid Hills Baptist Church, Atlanta, GA, preserved and hosted by the Southern Baptist Historical Library & Archives. Not affiliated with or endorsed by SBHLA; for personal use only.

item.description: Sermon by Louie D. Newton, longtime pastor of Druid Hills Baptist Church, Atlanta, GA, preached October 21, 1956. item.title: Louie D. Newton — The Cure of Sin (date unknown)
item.description: Sermon by Louie D. Newton, longtime pastor of Druid Hills Baptist Church, Atlanta, GA. SBHLA's own listing gives no date for this recording ("No Date" in their catalog); it is placed last in this feed with a nominal date for ordering purposes only, not a claim about when it was actually preached. Transferred by SBHLA from a reel-to-reel audio recording.
